name: Spotless Web App
alt_id: Tangkapan layar proyek Spotless Web App
desc_id: Sistem manajemen SaaS 3 portal yang menopang ekosistem cuci mobil Spotless. React 19 + TypeScript + Recharts, dengan antarmuka POS real-time, manajemen keranjang, dan multi-pembayaran (Tunai, Debit, QRIS).
desc_en: A 3-portal SaaS management system running the Spotless car wash ecosystem. React 19 + TypeScript + Recharts, with a real-time POS interface, cart management, and multi-payment support.
